WLED Oval / Polar Ledmap Generator

Places LEDs on concentric ovals, snaps each one to the nearest cell of an oversized 2D matrix, and writes a sparse ledmap.json (empty cells are -1).

Fixture
Wiring
0° = top (12 o'clock); angles increase clockwise. Every ring starts at the start angle, viewed from the front.
Matrix
Smaller cells = more accurate placement, but more RAM and render time. Max 255×255.
Preview
ledmap.json
In WLED: set the LED count under LED Preferences to the total LED count, upload this as /ledmap.json via /edit, then reboot.
